description: Defines the InlineEvent template struct for managing CUDA/MPS events, including recording, querying, timing, and synchronization functionalities within the c10::impl namespace.

classes.name: InlineEvent
classes.description: A template struct managing device events for synchronization and timing, supporting move semantics, recording, blocking, querying, and elapsed time measurement.

methods.name: recordOnce
methods.description: Records the event on the given stream if it has not been marked for recording.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records the event on the specified stream, ensuring device type matches.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Blocks the stream until the event is completed, if it was marked for recording.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Checks if the event has completed.

methods.name: elapsedTime
methods.description: Calculates the elapsed time between this event and another, with checks for device type and timing enablement.

methods.name: synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes the event, waiting for its completion.
